{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: 1/2 Push Connect Valve,CEKER 1/2 inch OD Quick Connect Tube Fittings Pneumatic Valve Push Fittings Union Straight Air Flow Control Valve 1Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for a pneumatic valve, and the tubing size would need to match my setup.
ItemID: 2; Title: LABALPHA 6Pcs PTFE Magnetic Stirrer Mixer Stir Bar, Magnetic Stir Bar, Olive Shape, 50mm/1.96 inch Length; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My resin work does not establish a need for magnetic stir bars, and I do not have a matching stirrer in my recent purchases.
ItemID: 3; Title: ULIBERMAGNET Magnetic Hooks, Cordless Drill Hooks Heavy Duty,Power Tool Organizer,Large Manget with Hooks for Workshop Organization,2 Pack Tool Hooks for Drill,Garden Tool(Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these to keep my frequently used tools accessible, provided I have a suitable steel mounting surface.
ItemID: 4; Title: 1/4"-20 x 3" Stainless Steel Button Head Socket Cap Screws with Hex Nuts, Flat Washers and Lock Washers Hardware Assortment, 304 Stainless Steel, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, 10 Sets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These complement my UNC rivet nuts and hardware kits, though I would check that the three-inch length suits the job.
ItemID: 5; Title: Stem Caster Wheels 4 inch Heavy Duty Threaded Stem Mount Casters Set of 4 with American Size UNC 1/2"-13 x 1" Swivel Industrial Castors with Safety Dual Locking Wheel for Furniture and Cart; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These could help with a future workshop cart, but I have no current project requiring this stem size.
ItemID: 6; Title: Lichamp Step Drill Bit Set for Metal Sheet Heavy Duty, 5-Piece HSS Step Up Down Drill Bits Stepper Unibit for Steel Hole, 50 Sizes from 1/8 to 1-3/8 inches, B105RD; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose these for enlarging sheet-metal holes for rivets and threaded inserts, complementing my existing twist drill bits.
ItemID: 7; Title: QEZEZA 10 Packs of Vinyl Coated Ceiling Hooks, 2.9-inch Silver Spiral Hooks, Plant Hooks, Kitchen Hooks, Hanging Hooks, Kitchen Hooks for Indoor and Outdoor use (White); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in fabrication and tool mounting right now than ceiling or plant hanging.
ItemID: 8; Title: VIGRUE 1/4 x 1" to 3" Hex Lag Bolts, 108PCS 1/4 Hex Lag Screws Wood Screws Washers Assortment kit 18-8(304) Stainless Steel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would add these for heavier wood fastening where my smaller screw assortments are less suitable.
ItemID: 9; Title: Learay 10 Pack Rubber Coated Magnets, 26LBS Neodymium Magnet Base with M6 Threaded Studs, Strong Mounting Magnets Stud Magnet Black Rare Earth Magnets for Light Bar Mirror Camera Tool; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These offer removable mounting options for workshop accessories and could work with my metric hardware, subject to checking thread compatibility.
ItemID: 10; Title: 8 Hair Drain Clog Remover Tool Kits, 2 Sewer Cleaning Rods, 6 PP Material Cleaning Tools for Cleaning Sewers, Kitchen Sinks, Bathroom, Toilets; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would buy these for an actual clogged drain, but they do not support my current fabrication and fastening interests."}
